title: Normalized solutions of quasilinear Schrödinger-Poisson system with critical nonlinear term in bounded domain
summary: This work examines a quasilinear Schrödinger-Poisson system involving a critical nonlinearity, expressed as \[ -Δu + φu + λu = |u|^{q-2} u + |u|^4 u, \quad x \in Ω_r, \] \[ -Δφ- \varepsilon^4 Δ_4 φ= u^2, \qquad\qquad\qquad\quad\ x \in Ω_r, \] \[ \enspace u = φ= 0, \qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\enspace\ \ \,x \in \partial Ω_r \] subject to the normalized condition \[ \int_{Ω_r} |u|^2\, \mathrm d x = b^2. \] Here $\varepsilon > 0$, $q \in (2, 8/3)$, $Ω_r \subset \mathbb R^3$ is a bounded domain.
